design: Frozen-routing query output value edits split by first value occurrence, second value occurrence, non-final-token keys, final token, and remaining separators. Token offsets from original prompts determine roles; token ids checked against captured examples. Mixed and local-stream role edits, both value occurrences jointly, exact partition sums; no fitting. Same H778alignment gate.
limitations: Final token can be punctuation in colon/equals formats; keys means all key tokens except final token. Contextual local values, not raw word identities. Source-role masks defined from prompt, not model outputs. No additive downstream causal fractions.
